tools.name: connect_status
tools.description: Poll a connect request. Returns pending | denied | expired, or — once approved — the app id and the API TOKEN (returned exactly once: save it to the project's .env immediately, never print it in logs). The token is SCOPED (read, invoices, subscriptions, webhooks) — it cannot move money out of the ap

tools.name: getMe
tools.description: Verify the token: app id, name, webhook config, token scopes.

tools.name: getBalance
tools.description: Merchant app balance per asset (available + onhold).

tools.name: getCurrencies
tools.description: Supported crypto assets (code/name/decimals) and fiats.

tools.name: getExchangeRates
tools.description: Current asset↔fiat display rates.

tools.name: getStats
tools.description: App volume/count stats for a period.

tools.name: getInvoices
tools.description: List invoices (newest first).

tools.name: getChecks
tools.description: List checks.

tools.name: getTransfers
tools.description: List app→user transfers.

tools.name: getInvoicePayments
tools.description: List the receipts of one invoice for reconciliation: the wallet payment and every transfer that came to its payment address (paid, pending, late, review), with the amount, sender and tx hash.

tools.name: getWithdrawals
tools.description: List the app's on-chain withdrawals and their status.

tools.name: getWithdrawAddresses
tools.description: List the app's saved withdrawal addresses (address_id, network, address, memo, when each becomes usable).

tools.name: getWithdrawFees
tools.description: What a withdrawal costs per asset and network: the network fee charged on top of the amount (`fee`; `fee_empty` to a never-used address where it differs) and the least amount.

tools.name: getWithdrawalLinks
tools.description: List the app's withdrawal links (status active | expired | deleted), newest first.

tools.name: getExchangePairs
tools.description: Assets the app balance can be exchanged between (any two differing ones are a pair) and the USD limits.

tools.name: getExchangeEstimate
tools.description: Preview an exchange of the app balance at the current rate; moves nothing.

tools.name: getExchanges
tools.description: List the app's balance exchanges.

tools.name: getSubscriptionPlans
tools.description: List subscription plans.

tools.name: getSubscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (subscribers).

tools.name: createInvoice
tools.description: Create a one-off payment invoice; the payer opens result.mini_app_invoice_url. See the invoices doc.

tools.name: deleteInvoice
tools.description: Delete an unpaid invoice.

tools.name: getInvoiceAddress
tools.description: The invoice's own payment address for your checkout page: the payer sends `amount` of `asset` on `network` (plus `memo` when set) before `expires_at`; the invoice is paid by itself once it arrives. A repeat call returns the same address and never extends the window. Show the amount, the network and

tools.name: editCheck
tools.description: Set or clear the description an active check's page shows. No money moves.

tools.name: createWithdrawalLink
tools.description: A link that opens the wallet's Withdraw form for the PERSON who taps it, with your address (and optionally network, amount, memo) filled in — they confirm the withdrawal from their own balance. No app money moves. 403 `withdrawal_link_unavailable` while the feature is off.

tools.name: deleteWithdrawalLink
tools.description: Switch a withdrawal link off before its term — it stops opening the form at once.

tools.name: deleteCheck
tools.description: Delete an unclaimed check (refunds the hold).

tools.name: createSubscriptionPlan
tools.description: Create an IMMUTABLE recurring-billing plan; send payers to result.mini_app_subscribe_url. See the subscriptions doc.

tools.name: archiveSubscriptionPlan
tools.description: Stop new signups for a plan (live subscriptions keep renewing).

tools.name: cancelSubscription
tools.description: Stop future charges for one subscription (paid time runs out).

tools.name: updateApp
tools.description: Update app name / webhook_url (https) / webhook_events opt-in list. Needs the 'webhooks' scope (the connect-issued token has it) or the primary token. See the webhooks doc for the event types and signature verification.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getInvoicePayments · Private data: connect, connect_status, getMe, getInvoicePayments, createWithdrawalLink, updateApp · Public sink: getMe, createSubscriptionPlan · Destructive: deleteInvoice, deleteCheck.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getInvoicePayments · Private data: connect, connect_status, getMe, getInvoicePayments, createWithdrawalLink, updateApp · Public sink: getMe, createSubscriptionPlan · Destructive: deleteInvoice, deleteCheck

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_docs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read a TgPay Merchant API integration doc. START HERE before integrating: topics quickstart, invoices, subscriptions, transfers-checks, webhooks, errors."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
